author: mvafin
title: JS API artifact download fails with ListArtifacts ECONNREFUSED on self-hosted Windows runner
signature: Failed to ListArtifacts: Unable to make request: ECONNREFUSED|Network

failed_jobs.name: JS API (22)
failed_jobs.symptom: akashchi/download-artifact step fails: Failed to ListArtifacts: Unable to make request: ECONNREFUSED while fetching openvino_js_package artifact

key_errors: 2026-11-03T16:17:43.1997744Z ##[error]Action failed with error: Failed to ListArtifacts: Unable to make request: ECONNREFUSED
2026-11-03T16:17:43.2051098Z ##[error]Unable to download artifact(s): Failed to ListArtifacts: Unable to make request: ECONNREFUSED
root_cause: The self-hosted Windows runner could not reach the GitHub Actions ArtifactService (results.api.v1.ArtifactService/ListArtifacts) endpoint when the download-artifact action attempted to fetch the openvino_js_package artifact, receiving a TCP connection refusal (ECONNREFUSED). This is a transient network/infrastructure connectivity issue between the self-hosted runner and GitHub's artifact storage backend, not a code defect in the PR; a second attempt of the same run (attempt 2) succeeded for the equivalent 'JS API (22)' job on the same commit, confirming the failure was not deterministic.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible outside CI; depends on transient runner-to-GitHub network connectivity at the time of the run.
recommended_actions: Re-run only the failed job(s) (already succeeded on attempt 2 for this run)
Monitor the self-hosted Windows runner pool for recurring ECONNREFUSED connectivity issues to the GitHub Actions artifact service
If this signature keeps recurring, consider adding retry/backoff wrapping around akashchi/download-artifact or escalating to infra team for the AKS-hosted runner network egress
prevention_strategies: Add automatic retry with backoff around artifact download/upload steps on self-hosted runners, and track ECONNREFUSED-to-ArtifactService incidents to detect broader connectivity degradations early.
historical_context: This exact signature (Failed to ListArtifacts: Unable to make request: ECONNREFUSED | Network) has been recorded 4 prior times (pattern 1808e665f1f70825, first seen 2026-07-01, last seen 2026-08-28) across unrelated PRs, always resolved by a rerun. Related but distinct ECONNREFUSED signatures exist for CreateArtifact/FinalizeArtifact phases (patterns b6957c2b9e09de1c, 0c33a04c2cbe783c) and other artifact names (b889d24cd154d2dd, c903843ea6da862b).
